_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. fourmula.ai's marketing layer declares a small Webflow variable set (fluid --_fonts---* sizes, the --fonts-* alpha ink ramp, themed --mainbg/--secondbg/--lines/--menu* colours) which lands as {var} leaves resolved per theme; .body.dark paints light and plain .body paints dark, so `light` resolves the .body.dark declarations and `dark` the .body ones. Painted control colours and all geometry are measured literals. The dark-only app.fourmula.ai Tailwind theme (--color-*, --text-*, --radius-*, --spacing, --ease-*, --blur-*) lands under core.* as literals resolved from raw/css-vars-app.json; its measured surfaces live under component.app.*.
